candidate_dedup_policy: conservative effective configuration; fp/fingerprint and unknown operational fields are significant; display name/fragment and query order are cosmetic; VLESS omitted encryption/security normalize to none; repeated query fields are kept conservatively distinct
geography_policy: disabled; geography is not checked and never affects admission
ranking_policy: Mihomo first allows only nodes with 0 < Cloudflare delay < 500 ms before the service cascade. After every mandatory service probe has passed, Mihomo measures the survivors again. Only nodes with 0 < FINAL delay < 500 ms are eligible for publication. Publish up to 100 eligible nodes ordered by the lowest FINAL Mihomo delay; preliminary and service-probe latency are not used for TOP-100 ordering

probe_policy.whatsapp_core: e1/e2 checked in parallel; ports 443/5222 checked in parallel per endpoint; e3 only if needed; require 2 of 3 endpoints; timeout 2s per endpoint stage
probe_policy.instagram_https: mandatory availability gate through VPN; any real HTTPS response from www.instagram.com passes; TLS/connect/timeout/no HTTP response fails; latency does not affect TOP-100 ranking
probe_policy.mihomo_precheck: pre-cascade native Mihomo group delay test; test URL https://cp.cloudflare.com; timeout 5000 ms; only nodes with 0 < delay < 500 ms are admitted to the service cascade
probe_policy.mihomo_final_ping: post-cascade native Mihomo group delay test against the same Cloudflare URL https://cp.cloudflare.com; timeout 5000 ms; only nodes with 0 < FINAL delay < 500 ms are eligible for publication; ascending FINAL delay is the sole TOP-100 ranking metric among eligible nodes

admission_rule: Geography and preliminary DNS latency filters are disabled. Every deduplicated candidate is first tested by Mihomo itself against Cloudflare; only nodes with 0 < delay < 500 ms are admitted to the service cascade. Survivors must then pass every mandatory service probe. After the cascade, Mihomo performs a second fresh Cloudflare delay test. Only nodes with 0 < FINAL delay < 500 ms are eligible for publication, and TOP-100 is ordered strictly by that final delay.
note: Node age does not matter. Previous nodes and new nodes are treated equally on every run. Preliminary Mihomo latency is an admission filter requiring delay below 500 ms. Service-probe latency is admission telemetry only. Final Mihomo latency must also be below 500 ms and is the sole TOP-100 ordering metric among eligible nodes. Client AUTO uses the same Cloudflare test URL.
